description:
Log in to OSCAR EMR and update the status of an existing consultation request. 

1. Login with username 'oscardoc', password 'oscar', and PIN '1117'.
2. Search for patient 'Robert Crawley'.
3. Locate the PENDING consultation request for 'Dr. Alice Wong' (Cardiology) sent approximately 3 weeks ago.
4. Update the status of this specific request to 'Completed' (or 'Consult Received') to indicate the specialist report has arrived.

Note: Do NOT create a new consultation request. You must update the existing one.
